rows.en:
Ranka: "Here I'll explain the Anti-Missile Action."
Sheryl: "Keep up with our explanation at Macross speed!"
rows.notes: 'Macross speed' renders makurosupiido, a play on 'Macross' + speed; kept literal.

rows.en: Practice the new special maneuvers.

Sheryl: "Last of all, I'll explain the newly added controls."
Ranka: "Thanks so much for listening all the way to the end!"
Train at the ground training field.

Sheryl: "Now you're going to do combat training at the ground training field.
         There are targets on the field too, so train however you like."
Train at the space training field.

Ranka: "Now you're going to do combat training at the space training field!
        There are targets on the field too, so train however you like!"
Train at the in-base training field.

Sheryl: "Now you're going to do combat training at the in-base training field.
         There are targets on the field too, so train however you like."
Train at the indoor training field.

Ranka: "Now you're going to do combat training at the indoor training field!
        There are targets on the field too, so train however you like!"
Train at the flight training field.

Sheryl: "Now you're going to do combat training at the flight training field.
         There are targets on the field too, so train however you like."

TYPE-14
A U.N. Forces fighter developed as the TYPE-4's successor.
It specializes in fleet air defense.

ADR-03-Mk III Cheyenne
An early Destroid fixed on the carrier Asuka as an AA battery.
It fought hard against SV-51s to defend the Asuka.

VF-0D Phoenix
The two-seat VF-0 of Shin and Edgar. Its two seats suggest a
trainer, but it outmaneuvers the A type in air combat.

VF-0A Phoenix
The standard VF-0, flown mostly by rank-and-file pilots. It
fought fierce variable fighter battles with the Anti-U.N. Forces.

VF-0S Phoenix (Roy)
Flown by Roy Focker in a new kind of transforming dogfight
against Ivanov, an Anti-U.N. pilot and his former superior.
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept. Japanese label says 'Focker's unit'; the prefilled '(Roy)' is left as MUF shipped it.

rows.en:
HWR-00-Mk I Prototype Monster
Prototype of the super-heavy Monster. The U.N. Forces' trump
card, it fired reaction weapons at the Bird Human.

TYPE-29
An Anti-U.N. Forces fighter, developed to counter the TYPE-14.
It excels in local-theater combat.

SV-51α (Standard)
An Anti-U.N. Forces variable fighter. Its original swing-wing
design makes it agile despite its size. Fought on Mayan Island.

SV-51γ (Nora)
Upgraded SV-51α. It gave the U.N.'s Shin Kudo a hard fight and took Sara, the Mayan Island priestess privy to the Bird Human's secret.
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept. Review: restored 'Mayan Island' (in the Japanese, dropped in English). Compressed to keep 2 wrapped lines.

rows.en:
SV-51γ (Ivanov)
Flown by Ivanov, Focker's former CO. It fought Focker's VF-0S
in a duel to the death. It bears a red skull as its personal mark.

Octos
An amphibious Anti-U.N. Destroid. Deployed en masse for the
Mayan Island landing, it made full use of being amphibious.

Bird Human (AFOS)
A god from Mayan Island legend. The U.N. and Anti-U.N. Forces
fought over its power, said to be enough to destroy the world.

ADR-04-Mk X Defender
Twin AA guns on both arms and a big radar for very long-range
space combat. Defended the Macross in place of gun batteries.

MBR-07-Mk II Spartan
Built for melee with giant aliens. After the war, it also put
down riots by aliens who could not adjust to life on Earth.

SDR-04-Mk XII Phalanx
Missiles packed on both arms. With too few batteries after the
Zentradi raid, it served as the Macross's anti-air fire.

MBR-04-Mk IV Tomahawk
Big beam cannons on both arms, plus missiles, MGs and more.
Ready for any front: ship assaults, city defense, interception.

HWR-00-Mk II Monster
Four big cannons on its head, missile launchers on its arms.
The U.N. Forces' top firepower, but heavy arms make it slow.

VF-1D Valkyrie
The two-seat VF-1A, used mainly for training. Caught up in the
Zentradi raid, Hikaru Ichijyo flew it and saved Minmay.

VF-1A Valkyrie (Standard)
The Macross's most common variable fighter, flown by regular
pilots. It can handle any battlefield, from the ground to space.

VF-1A Valkyrie (Max)
Max's personal unit, painted blue. Same specs as the standard
model, but its genius pilot drew the eyes of friend and foe.

VF-1J Valkyrie (Hikaru)
Hikaru Ichijyo's unit after he became a U.N. Forces pilot.
It beats the A type, and twin head lasers add firepower.

VF-1J Valkyrie (Max)
Issued to Max after he married Milia. It too is painted blue.
Flying with Milia's red unit, he racked up even more victories.

VF-1J Valkyrie (Milia)
Issued to Milia after she married Max. It too is painted red.
Flying with Max's blue unit, she racked up even more victories.

VF-1S Valkyrie Roy Focker Special
A high-performance unit for commander-class pilots. After
Focker fell, his junior Hikaru flew it to defend the Macross.

SDF-1 Macross Daedalus Type
An alien battleship that suddenly fell to Earth. Through it,
humanity met OverTechnology far beyond any existing tech.

VT-1 Super Ostrich
A two-seat trainer. Hikaru took it without permission for a
Saturn date with Minmay, but the Zentradi captured them.

VF-1A Valkyrie (Hikaru)
Hikaru's VF-1A from the movie. Flying it, he defied Misa's
orders to rescue Minmay, and so the love triangle began.

VF-1S Valkyrie (Hikaru)
A high-performance unit for commanders. In the final battle, it
charged the foe's ship with the Macross and beat Boddole Zer.

VF-1S Valkyrie (Max)
A high-performance unit for commander-class pilots. Max flew
it as Skull Squadron leader and won his duel with Milia.

VF-4 Lightning III
Developed as the VF-1's successor. When the Megaroad-01 set
out, Hikaru flew it as the ship's air group commander.

SDF-1 Macross Armored Type
An alien battleship that suddenly fell to Earth. In the movie,
unlike the TV series, it has ARMD-01 and ARMD-02 as its arms.

Regult
The Zentradi forces' most widely used battle pod. Swapping
weapons suits it to any operation. The troops think it's so-so.

Glaug
A high-performance unit with big cannons on both arms, plus
many lasers and guns. Quamzin's unit, it plagued the Macross.

Nousjadeul-Ger (TV)
A humanoid powered combat suit, nimbler and comfier than
a Regult, with shoulder cannons and many handheld weapons.

Nousjadeul-Ger (Movie)
A humanoid powered combat suit, nimbler and comfier than
the Regult. Its design differs between TV and movie.

Queadluun-Rau (Standard)
A high-performance Meltrandi battle suit. Highly mobile, it
menaced Valkyrie squadrons with big guns and many missiles.

Queadluun-Rau (Milia)
Milia's red personal unit, unbeaten and feared even by allies.
After a fierce dogfight, Max got on its tail and shot it down.

Queadluun-Rau (Max)
The blue unit Max flew after marrying Milia and growing to
Zentradi size. Paired with Milia's unit, it scored big wins.

Zentradi Soldier
A Zentradi rank-and-file soldier. Despite wearing only a space
suit, at over 10 m tall they can match a Battroid hand to hand.

HWR-00-Mk II Monster (Ridden by Quamzin)
A Monster with a delighted Boss Quamzin astride it. Apparently
he wanted to imitate a Western he'd once seen.

Vrlitwhai Kridanik
A Zentradi fleet commander. Tougher than common troops, he
can briefly work unprotected in space. A strong fighter too.

Golg Boddole Zer
Zentradi Commander-in-Chief. Core bio-unit of a mobile
fortress built 120,000 cycles ago; bigger than other Zentradi.

VF-11B Thunderbolt
Developed to succeed the VF-1 as main fighter. Isamu flew it
while hunting Zentradi remnants scattered across space.

YF-19 Excalibur (Isamu)
New engines gave it high mobility but made it hard to handle --
a wild bronco that Isamu called his "little cutie."
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept. '--' is plain ASCII (no em dash).

rows.en:
YF-21 Sturmvogel (Guld)
A unit piloted by brain waves. To stop Sharon's new unmanned
fighter Ghost, Guld made a suicide charge that downed both.

X-9 Ghost
An unmanned fighter hijacked by Sharon Apple. Its very high
mobility toyed with Guld, but his suicide charge downed both.

VF-11C Thunderbolt
The U.N. Forces' main unit from 2040 on. Its forgiving handling
and easy upkeep kept it the mainstay for a long time.

VF-17D Nightmare (Standard)
A stealth unit for special missions, large and heavily armed.
After the Protodeviln appeared, it mainly defended City 7.

VF-17S Nightmare (Kinryu/Gamlin)
A VF-17 upgraded for commanders. After leader Kinryu died,
Gamlin became leader of Diamond Force and flew this unit.

VF-17S Nightmare (Milia)
To protect City 7, cut off from the fleet by an enemy ploy,
Mayor Milia flew this VF-17S, repainted red.

VF-19F Excalibur (Standard)
Deployed to Emerald Force. The YF-19's peaky handling was
toned down so that rank-and-file pilots could fly it.

VF-19S Excalibur (Docker)
Docker's unit as leader of Emerald Force. Unlike the standard
unit, it adds four anti-air beam guns for more firepower.

VF-22S Sturmvogel II (Max)
Max sortied in it to attack the Protodeviln nest. A high-end
unit packed with new tech, such as solo fold capability.

VF-22S Sturmvogel II (Milia)
Milia's red unit. She fought beside Max in Operation Stargazer,
and once even sang in it with a Sound Booster fitted.

VF-19 Kai Fire Valkyrie (Basara)
A modified VF-19. Its bright red frame has a big speaker and
speaker pods, and it roamed the galaxy blaring Basara's songs.

VF-11MAXL Kai Mylene Valkyrie (Mylene)
A VF-11 modified for Mylene, its Battroid mode distinctly
feminine. She sang with Basara, the battlefield her stage.

VF-17T Kai Storm Valkyrie (Ray & Veffidas)
A modified VF-17T. Ray and Veffidas flew it together as
FIRE BOMBER members, firing up live shows even in battle.

Battle 7
Macross 7 fleet flagship, captained by Maximilian Jenius. Its
trump card, the Macross Cannon, got it through many crises.

Queadluun-Quilqua
An upgraded, modified Queadluun-Rau. Emilia Jenius, daughter of Max and Milia, flew it in a singing showdown with Basara.

Fz-109A Elgersoln (Standard)
A variable fighter for rank-and-file Varauta Army pilots. Said
to derive from the U.N.'s VF-14, but nobody knows for sure.

Fz-109F Elgersoln (Gigile)
The Fz-109's commander model. Mainly Gigile's, it attacked
Basara & co. repeatedly; Gamlin's team downed it over City 7.

Az-130A Panzersoln
A variable attacker the Varauta Army made by upgrading the
Elgersoln. Its extra power made life harder still for Macross 7.

FBz-99G Zaubergeran (Gavil)
Gavil's own unit, a mighty variable bomber with all sorts of
weapons. Supposedly. Yet Gamlin often downed it in one hit.

Queadluun-Rau (Chlore)
Personal unit of Chlore, who leads a rogue Meltrandi fleet.
Pilot skill plus performance let it land a hit on Basara himself.
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept. Chlore's gender is unknown in the glossary; the line uses no pronoun for Chlore.

rows.en:
Glavil
Gavil's physical body. It needs so much Spiritia that Gavil takes
a small spirit form, merging into Gavigla to fight all-out.

Gepelnitchi
Leader of the Protodeviln. To build a world of endless Spiritia,
he attacks humans, the "Spiritia-regenerating race" he sought.

VT-1C Valkyrie
A variable trainer for basic training. Basara flew it to make
the Galaxy Whale hear his song, but the whale shot it down.
rows.notes: Prefilled; kept. Japanese names it 'VT-1C Valkyrie' here, not 'Ostrich'.
